_specs: The design name comes from the Shopify image filename, the only record of what the print is. Nothing about the artwork is invented.
buyBody: Plain white. The most useful shirt in any golf wardrobe and the one that most courses will never question.
pieceParas: Every golfer needs a white polo and most of them own one that has gone gray. This is a replacement: four-way stretch, UPF 50+, and a collar that holds its shape.
There is no print, no contrast stitching and nothing to clash with. It is the shirt you pack when you do not know what the course is like.
lifestyleBrief: Portrait 4:5, on body, strong sun. White is the hardest color to expose — this brief needs a shot that keeps detail in the fabric rather than blowing the shirt out. There is no on-body apparel photography at all yet (HANDOFF §7b F).
